item.title: China Open Source Daily — 2026-08-14
item.description: Moonshot AI targets August 27 closing for its pre-IPO round ahead of a Hong Kong IPO filing, crystallizing the institutional transition from open-weight AI lab to listed entity; DeepSeek officially launches V4 Pro on August 13 at $0.435/M input tokens — the first frontier-class Chinese AI model priced for sustained revenue generation rather than cost-leadership signaling; The Guardian's August 7 institutional analysis challenges China's 'open ecosystem' narrative, arguing that China's open-weight AI ecosystem is no more open than its US counterpart. This cycle's briefing examines the institutional transition from subsidy-financed distribution to capital-market-financed licensing.

item.title: China Open Source Daily — 2026-08-11
item.description: DeepSeek releases V4-Flash under MIT license — the first Chinese frontier open-weight model under a truly permissive OSI-style license; Alibaba moves Qwen toward revenue-sharing for large commercial users, creating a new 'open weights, paid use' institutional form; Reuters and Yahoo report Beijing has met with Alibaba and ByteDance to discuss curbing overseas access to its most advanced AI models, moving the July export-control debate from rumor toward implementation.

item.title: China Open Source Daily — 2026-08-06
item.description: DeepSeek's $71B valuation and state-controlled governance structure expose a 'Chinese Dual Ownership' model; Moonshot AI closes $3.5B round at $35B as IPO wave institutionalizes AI wealth; Alibaba's Qwen3.8-Max launches with aggressive open-weight pricing.
